test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option (1): FYT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/809bc8c963a3e7a004406a73f995222ecb4e32773dbe192bfd631232d333eeb5.png] 

**Option (2): IBU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9b8793b8c00212ff090f6713c90a2ea5512f8b6e233497aa57c1fb81046b4ca.png] 

**Option (3): GZS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c9fc1f20f5aa66577aba2adf6988a06c024e16229733ed79ff4da4b8f5746b5.png] 

**Option (4): OHA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f74cbff1d7753e2b0e9b3d8959706905ba0928d3a2199a1579d20a73faa92003.png] 

The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is: FYT.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (1)"**
